rules.helps: win z >= 2 with share z > -2, or share z >= 2 with win z > -2, in the deciding regime
rules.deciding_regime: native when it resolves, else war when it resolves, else unresolved
rules.win_column: wins added per 10,000 games at the gene's measured on-rate in one native screen, (win_on - 1/players) * 10000; last and prior are the two most recent native screens that priced the gene
rules.default_on: both win columns positive, or their average above +15 with neither below -10; with exactly one populated column, on when it is above +20; unmeasured is off
